summary: Rework P1/P2 Core producer after controller review evt-20260622121836-0005. The previous commit fe563ee correctly removed draftPackage.intent and added complete-confirm validation, but it still leaves recommendation/top/order semantics in the Core Plan facts path: DimensionPlanningAidReport still defines/builds recommendedDimensions, dimensionOrder, maxRecommendedDimensions, subsetHints, and recommended constraint severity, and buildPlanDraftInformationPackage exposes the entire planningAids object through sourceReports. This conflicts with Design/docs/current/alembic-recipe-plan-no-guess-correction-2026-06-22.md lines 28-37 and group A lines 43-56: Plan facts are confirmed facts, not recommendations/top-N/order; Plugin/Core must not recommend, rank, top-slice, or curate dimensions for the authoritative Plan. Scope: remove or neutralize these Core public/report fields from the Plan path; expose only factual dimension signal/selection/evidence reports for the Agent; information-gathering steps must be derived without top-N slicing/order-as-decision; tests must assert no recommended/top/order/subset/default-order leak from the draft information package or Plan-path report. If a non-Plan legacy consumer truly still needs old fields, keep it out of the Plan path with an explicit consumer/migration note rather than exposing it to sourceReports. Preserve the good work from fe563ee: no draft intent, confirm requires complete Agent PlanIntent+rationale, stop-write planning_brief_json, read-time generation-state projection, and resolvePlanDimensionDefinitions canonical confirmed-id API. Do not edit AlembicPlugin/Alembic/Dashboard in this package; do not add compatibility/fallback/renamed recommendation semantics. Return TargetResultEnvelope with commit, changed files, exact tests, and rg evidence for recommendedDimensions/dimensionOrder/maxRecommendedDimensions/subsetHints/top in Core Plan path.
